body:
Hi @mdunbavan. Thanks for opening this issues.

One thing that I notice that makes your display empty is that there are no attributes in your records, just highlighted values. There must be something wrong in your index configuration (have you set some unretrievable attributes?).

On the IS.js part, it actually adds your template markup to the document for each of your result (and in your jsFiddle there is only one result).

Let me know if I misunderstood something here.
